An intelligent solution for learning and practicing __image recognition & automation__.

</div>

## 🚀 Features

<div align="left">

🤖 __Auto Battle__: Supports advanced customization with custom logic, skill tags, conditions, variables, and more.

🛡️ __Dodge Assistant__: Uses an integrated audio and visual recognition model with low resource usage and high accuracy.

🧹 __Daily Cleanup__: Completes daily tasks including the video store, scratch cards, coffee shop, materials, rewards, and more.

☕ __Hollow Operations__: A feature module for recognition, events, and pathfinding trained with large models.

⏲️ __More Features__: Scheduled launch, multi-account switching, scheduled tasks, automatic dialogue, and more.

</div>
